sources.title: LEONARDO user guide
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: JUPITER：模組化服務管線的瓶頸轉移
related.titleEn: JUPITER: bottleneck migration in a modular service pipeline
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 manifest、事件時間線、資料損壞與版本不符兩個拒絕案例，以及 200/220 秒核算；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the manifest, event timeline, separate corrupted-data and incompatible-version rejection cases, and the 200/220-second calculations. Record which evidence proves availability and which proves scientific correctness. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 定義 item_id、前處理完成、求解完成與驗證狀態；用離散事件表追蹤五分鐘的佇列，而非僅列模組峰值。
related.differenceEn: Define item_id, preprocessing completion, solve completion and validation status. Build a five-minute event ledger with queue lengths so module peak rates can be checked against actual item conservation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 此串行模型的關鍵路徑為前處理時間加傳輸時間加求解時間；資料驗證已包含在前處理，不能再假設未宣告的重疊；前處理 120 秒、求解 60 秒、產物 40 GB；有效傳輸率由 2 改為 1 GB/s；名義式 120+40/2+60 = 200 s；變更式 120+40/1+60 = 220 s。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
無丟棄且每件工作各經兩服務一次時，穩態輸出率上限為兩服務率的最小值；此式不含啟動延遲或批次填充；前處理固定每分鐘 10 件；加速服務由每分鐘 6 件提升為 12 件；每件工作大小與驗證條件相同；名義式 min(10,6) = 6 items/min；變更式 min(10,12) = 10 items/min。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: In this serial model, the critical path adds preprocessing, transfer and solve times. Validation is included in preprocessing, and undeclared overlap is not permitted when computing the promised completion time. Preprocessing takes 120 seconds, solving takes 60 seconds and the artifact is 40 decimal GB. Effective transfer rate changes from 2 to 1 GB/s; these are synthetic end-to-end rates, not interconnect specifications. Nominal 120+40/2+60 = 200 s; changed 120+40/1+60 = 220 s. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

With no drops and one visit to each stage per item, the steady-state output ceiling is the smaller service rate. This bound excludes pipeline startup, batching, finite buffers and additional revisits. The synthetic preprocessing stage serves 10 items per minute. Accelerator service rises from 6 to 12 items per minute, with unchanged item size and validation requirements. All rates are teaching assumptions. Nominal min(10,6) = 6 items/min; changed min(10,12) = 10 items/min. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TLB reach：頁面粒度與工作視窗的適配
related.titleEn: TLB reach: matching translation granularity to the working window
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 manifest、事件時間線、資料損壞與版本不符兩個拒絕案例，以及 200/220 秒核算；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the manifest, event timeline, separate corrupted-data and incompatible-version rejection cases, and the 200/220-second calculations. Record which evidence proves availability and which proves scientific correctness. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 建立頁面大小、entry 數、工作視窗與存取跨度表；將實際處理器資料欄留為未量測，避免套用教學容量。
related.differenceEn: Build a table of page size, entry count, working-window size and access stride. Mark real-processor fields as unmeasured so the hypothetical entry counts cannot be mistaken for discovered hardware properties.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 此串行模型的關鍵路徑為前處理時間加傳輸時間加求解時間；資料驗證已包含在前處理，不能再假設未宣告的重疊；前處理 120 秒、求解 60 秒、產物 40 GB；有效傳輸率由 2 改為 1 GB/s；名義式 120+40/2+60 = 200 s；變更式 120+40/1+60 = 220 s。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

理想完全相聯且同頁面大小的 reach 為 entry_count*page_size；比較工作視窗時必須使用相同二進位單位；假設兩個獨立配置都可使用 64 個對應頁面大小的 entry；名義頁面 2 MiB，變更 4 KiB；名義式 64*2 = 128 MiB；變更式 64*4/1024 = 0.25 MiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: In this serial model, the critical path adds preprocessing, transfer and solve times. Validation is included in preprocessing, and undeclared overlap is not permitted when computing the promised completion time. Preprocessing takes 120 seconds, solving takes 60 seconds and the artifact is 40 decimal GB. Effective transfer rate changes from 2 to 1 GB/s; these are synthetic end-to-end rates, not interconnect specifications. Nominal 120+40/2+60 = 200 s; changed 120+40/1+60 = 220 s. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Under a fully associative, single-page-size idealization, reach equals entry count times page size. Use consistent binary units and keep this capacity bound distinct from measured miss behavior. Assume two hypothetical configurations each provide 64 entries for the relevant page size. Pages change from 2 MiB to 4 KiB; this does not assert any real processor has identical capacities for both sizes. Nominal 64*2 = 128 MiB; changed 64*4/1024 = 0.25 MiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
